translation.title: Terbinafine Hydrochloride Once Topical Solution
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for fungal skin infections caused by dermatophytes - tinea pedis (athlete's foot).
translation.usage: Before use, wash the affected area clean and dry it completely, then apply enough of the solution just once so that the affected area and its surroundings are thoroughly wetted. Even on the foot without visible lesions, spread a thin layer between all the toes of both feet, and apply the medicine over the entire sole and up to about 1.5 cm above the sole, then let it dry for 1 to 2 minutes until it forms a film. Do not rub it in when applying. For the medicine to work best, the treated skin should be left unwashed for 24 hours after application, so it is recommended to apply it after a shower or bath, wait until the same time the next day, and then wash your feet again.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, for children under 15, if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, or if you are breastfeeding. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have skin lesions that may be irritated by alcohol. Do not use an occlusive (airtight) dressing or wrapping unless directed by a doctor. This medicine is for external use only. Do not use it in the eyes (on the cornea or conjunctiva); if it gets into the eyes, rinse them completely with plenty of water. Do not use it on the face, nails, scalp, around the mouth, on the vaginal area, or on cracked or eroded (raw) skin. Adverse reactions may occur - very rarely rash, itching, blistering dermatitis and hives, and uncommonly dry skin, skin irritation or a burning sensation; if any of these occur, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at 15 to 30 degrees Celsius, keep out of reach of children, and keep away from open flames.
